purpose: PHD-MAIN-TRAINERR-v1 addendum 5: problem-making Gaussians (unbound, released, other-target) vs control, by place. Counting only, no new training, no method change.
fork_for_rendering: GeoGS-conf-guided-v1-r31 (read only; no new fork, no training)
interval_rule: interval (a, b]: start state = a ('0' for 0, '3000_pre_reset' for 3000), end state = b ('3000_pre_reset' for 3000)
reset_check_rule: member of the group in the <reset>_pre_reset state and not deleted in (reset, reset + 100] (delete events); first prune check after the reset is at reset + 100

kinds.0: 같은 목표에 묶인 것 (target_tag 1 and target_index in the place patches)
kinds.1: 다른 목표에 묶인 것 (target_tag 1, other patch)
kinds.3: 묶이지 않은 것 (target_tag 0: background seeds and their children)

floor_band.problem_group: Gaussian centre with normal offset dn in [0.2, 3.0] m above the target plane of a place point (dn = (x - anchor) . n_out of that point's column patch; GT point plane when the point has no patch) and tangent offset <= 0.25 m from that place point; group re-defined at each stage
floor_band.control_group: same rule on the floor_control points
floor_band.bound_floor_reference: addendum 4: Gaussians bound to floor_band patches (target_tag 1, target_index in the floor_band patches)

annex_under.problem_group: addendum 4 work da 4.3 (a4_da.wrong('annex')): pixels whose rendered surface lies on the wrong face (mesh vertices in the annex box > 1 m from GT); Gaussians giving weight within the wrong-face depth +- 0.5 m
annex_under.control_group: Gaussians drawing the roof at right-roof pixels (annex box mesh vertices <= 0.2 m from GT, not wall)

south_wall.problem_group: addendum 4 work da 4.3 (a4_da.wrong('south')): pixels of mesh vertices behind the south wall (> 0.64 m); Gaussians giving weight within that depth +- 0.5 m
south_wall.control_group: Gaussians drawing the long street-side wall (addendum3 place long_wall)

floater.problem_group: Gaussian centre within 0.5 m of an addendum3 work-ma edge floater face centre
floater.control_group: within 0.5 m of the control vertices (addendum3 ma)

runs.tl_B173nb_b10_ALS_s0: TRAINLOG B173 record run (scene dumps); no signed gradients -> work da = 확인 불가 and order 2.4 question

r1_lod2_wall1.problem_group: Gaussian centre 0.2-3 m in front (outward) of the target plane at the addendum4 ma cluster 1 lost points (tangent <= 0.25 m), at 30000
r1_lod2_wall1.control_group: same rule at kept wall points of the same scene (FINALTRAIN kept set, wall points of R1 x LoD2 within 30 m of cluster 1)

work_na.views: all training views whose image contains the pixel (maps index of the scene)
work_na.pixels: per view, pixel grid with stride 4 inside the union of the 3-sigma screen footprints of the problem/control group Gaussians; a pixel belongs to the group when the group's alpha*T sum > 1e-3
work_na.supervised: target depth finite and > 0 and map weight > 0 (jbgs_target.py loss rule)
work_na.weight_split: per pixel alpha*T before target - 1.96 sigma, within, after

work_da.position: -dL/dxyz . n_out (+ = away from the target plane)
work_da.scale_gradient: not recorded (trainlog r31 stores xyz and opacity only) -> 확인 불가

models.sa2: addendum 4 sa-2 (occluded-pixel supervision off) at the same iterations

work_ra.views: every training view whose image contains the point (owner not required)
work_ra.classes: rendered depth vs point depth: beyond (> truncation farther), stop (> truncation nearer), right (within truncation); truncation from the mesh code

work_ma.seeds: addendum 4 work ra fate: seeds first bound to a wrong target (fixed points) that were deleted; control = seeds first bound to kept-point targets, deleted and survived; six record scenes
work_ma.values: addendum 4 work na definitions (open views, colour weight, front kinds) at the reset before deletion
